patch_description:
This hybrid retains the efficient threefold-symmetric equilateral-triangle construction from the current program, while incorporating the lower-tail stabilization and elitist differential-evolution ideas from the square-based implementation.

The search fixes the convex hull to an equilateral triangle, which is subsequently scaled to unit area. Therefore raw triangle area is exactly the requested normalized objective after scaling. Differential evolution uses a score dominated by the minimum triangle area but augmented by the mean of the twelve smallest areas, reducing fragile one-constraint solutions. Several finalists are then independently polished with projected sparse-coordinate perturbations, permitting controlled symmetry breaking while preserving feasibility inside the convex hull. All random behavior uses one fixed seed.
